title: Momoi Airi — We're Matching♥〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A Neighboring City's Mall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Perfect! We're here on time as planned!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, where's the line for the lucky bags...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right over there. See, that person must be a member of the staff.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, you're right... Yawn...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Someone's sleepy.
I guess that's only natural considering how early in the morning it is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That being said, you might not be able to get the bags you want if you don't pep yourself up by the time they start.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. Lucky bags are a knock-down drag-out fight, after all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nowadays, some shops sell them online, but there's something special about getting the bag you want in person.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Ena, I think I hear your phone ringing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Oh, Mizuki just sent me a message.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whoa, someone's up super early.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Actually, Mizuki said something about getting one of those bags online. Is that what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Probably. I get that you can only get these bags during New Year's, but I still don't understand why that would take priority over seeing you, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, I totally understand.
Lucky bags are the best deals you can get all year, after all.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm always willing to hang out, if we can make plans.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mizuki just asked, “Did you manage to get up?”
Yes, I'm awake! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's so thoughtful to look out for you like that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not thoughtful! Thoughtless! I don't have a problem with getting up early! Especially if it means getting to hang out with you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, I know!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's take a selfie together, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? A selfie?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I mean, what's the fun in just replying that I'm up?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, let's take a selfie that makes it look like we're having a ton of fun together. I'll even reply, “This shopping spree's gonna be so amazing♪”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, look! Not only do we have matching hairstyles today, we've both tied off our braids with the same ribbons but in different colors!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it would be nice to show off to someone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Hmm... Oh, let's use that mirror over there!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi, come closer.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, here goes our first one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, looks good!
No, but... There might be a better angle...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Take as many as you like.
It's not like we have anything else to do until everything gets started.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, on top of your hair looking great today, you also did an amazing job with your makeup.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I mean, here!
Your skin looks like it's been airbrushed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Of course it does!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I spent as much time on my makeup today as I do for a TV shoot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it's a shame that your disguise is covering up your face. I mean, you worked so hard.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's fine. I went all out because I knew I was seeing you today, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So as long as you've seen it, that means I've accomplished my mission.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, it's not often that we get to spend all of New Year's Day hanging out together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I wasn't about to do a half-hearted job on my makeup, disguise or no.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. You really went through all that trouble just for me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, and you should feel honored that you got me to put in so much effort.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course, your majesty.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, we gotta send Mizuki the best pic we can! Let's try a different pose next, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, sounds good!
